about.intro: SafePlace helps you find a shelter near you in Kyiv. It is informational only and does not give routes.
about.outdated: Everything may be out of date.
about.notLive: Labels show declared access. They are not a live “open now” status.
about.report: Tap “Give feedback” on any shelter to confirm or correct it. Always follow official alerts.
about.prototype: This frontend preview uses fictional records, illustrative map points and example distances. It does not provide verified shelter locations or routes. No submissions are sent.
